candidate_methods: quarterly training total ratios with frozen pooled fallback
selection_rule: Select lower monthly MAE on 2022 only after fitting 2020–2021; ties within 1e-9 prefer scalar. Refit the selected method once on 2020–2022. Never switch method using outer or external outcomes.
known_month_rule: Report all 24 outer months and a sensitivity result excluding the already published September 2024 (23 months). No previously observed month is used for inner selection.

external_evaluation.role: New out-of-time corroboration, not fitting or method selection

publication_gate: For a new region require 36 complete paired training months and 24 complete paired outer months, all 19 external months, and strictly lower monthly MAE plus no worse absolute signed bias than unadjusted common-grid VIIRS on each of: outer 24, outer excluding known month 23, external 19. Missing support or any failed comparison withholds adjustment. Report all candidates, not just selected.
application_period_if_gate_passes: 2020-01-01/2026-07-31, full evaluated study area only; complete SP months
pantanal_exception: Original validation and factors remain immutable and published only in their 2020–2024 domain. Report the inner selection and 19 new external months as an audit. Do not replace or extend the frozen Pantanal publication before 24 fresh complete paired evaluation months are available.
peak_rule: Six highest observed MODIS activity months within each evaluation partition, month ascending for ties; never rank by candidate residuals.
nrt_sp_join: Require actual coincident acquisition windows for the same sensor, geometry and processing vintages. Current availability has no SP/NRT overlap; no joining/calibration across a temporal gap. Preserve NRT vintages for future paired re-extraction.
